title: Snorm-based Hölder Inequality in Mathlib 4.26+

problemStatement.formal: ∫⁻ f·g dμ ≤ (∫⁻ f^p dμ)^{1/p} · (∫⁻ g^q dμ)^{1/q} for conjugate exponents p,q
problemStatement.plain: Formalize Hölder's inequality using the eLpNorm API (renamed from snorm in Mathlib 4.26+), including the Cauchy-Schwarz specialization at p=q=2.
whyMatters: Fundamental inequality in analysis linking Lp norms
Bridges the full Young → Hölder → Cauchy-Schwarz → Minkowski hierarchy
Validates the Mathlib 4.26+ eLpNorm API (snorm renamed)

proven: Minkowski in eLpNorm form via eLpNorm_add_le
Minkowski L² from CS via norm-squared identity
knownResults.goal: Formalize Hölder's inequality in eLpNorm API — COMPLETED (0 sorries, 0 axioms)
